# Security policy

Wisp is pre-alpha software and has no supported production release yet. Security
reports about the current repository are still welcome.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not disclose vulnerability details in a public issue or pull request. If the
repository's [Security page][security] offers **Report a vulnerability**, use
that private channel.

If private reporting is unavailable, open a public issue titled `Security
contact request` with no technical details. A maintainer will arrange a private
channel before asking for the report.

In the private channel, include the affected revision, reproduction
conditions, expected impact, and the smallest safe proof you can provide. Do
not include real credentials, private user content, or production logs.

If a credential may have been exposed, revoke or rotate it immediately. A Git
history rewrite is not credential rotation.

[security]: https://github.com/gezilinll/wispwork/security
